Gilead To Hand $45,000,000 to Texas After Allegedly Using “Free Nurses” as Kickbacks To Boost Medicaid Prescriptions
summary:
Gilead Sciences has agreed to pay $45 million to settle Texas allegations that it used free nursing and reimbursement support services as kickbacks to influence Medicaid prescriptions. The company denies wrongdoing.
The post Gilead To Hand $45,000,000 to Texas After Allegedly Using “Free Nurses” as Kickbacks To Boost Medicaid Prescriptions appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Gilead Sciences has agreed to pay $45 million to settle allegations brought by Texas. The company was accused of using free nursing and reimbursement support services as kickbacks to improperly influence Medicaid prescriptions. Gilead has denied any wrongdoing in connection with the settlement.

Medicaid பரிந்துரைகளை செல்வாக்கு செலுத்த இலவச செவிலியர் சேவைகளை லஞ்சமாக பயன்படுத்தியதாக இந்நிறுவனம் மீது குற்றம் சாட்டப்பட்டது. இந்த விவகாரத்தில் Gilead எந்த தவறும் செய்யவில்லை என மறுத்துள்ளது.
